commit_message:
Fix the data race of VideoTrackRecorder::Encoder::pause_

|pause_| can be set on the main thread and read on the io thread
at the same time. Declaring |pause_| as an atomic variable
solves the data race problem.

Fuzzer report: https://clusterfuzz.com/testcase?key=5766664522432512

Bug: 988327

Summary: This code fragment defines the `Encoder` class, which handles video frame encoding in a thread-safe manner.

Parameters: 
N/A

Returns: 
N/A

Logic: The `Encoder` class inherits from `WTF::ThreadSafeRefCounted`, allowing for safe reference counting across threads. It includes a constructor that initializes encoding parameters and task runners for main and encoding threads. The `StartFrameEncode` method begins the encoding process for a given video frame, triggering necessary configurations and handling cases where frame data is not directly available. The class also provides mechanisms for pausing encoding, managing frame references, and completing the encoding process through callbacks. Various member variables are used to manage state, including a flag for paused encoding and task runners for different threading contexts. The destructor is designed to run on any of the associated task runners, ensuring proper cleanup.
